policy: At each frame begin, enable exact local rotation reuse only when the TAA setting is off. TAA on uses the original per-part matrix and normal calculations.
final_protocol: Native Wayland/Vulkan, Ryzen5 7500F/RTX4060,1920x1080,rd4,native resolution,VSync/OIT/dynamic lights off. Frozen seed7 world with256 NoAI/NoGravity zombie/cow/villager/spider mobs and zero particles. Four neighboring ABBA/BAAB pairs per TAA state, separate production processes,3s warmup/12s measurement. Games on silent workspace9. Counts/camera/size/streaming and no physical input during timed blocks asserted. No builds/tests/profiling/heavy analysis during timing.

original_unrestricted_control.protocol: Earlier Vulkan/X11 on the same hardware and scene,4 neighboring pairs per TAA state,3s warmup/8s measurement. This is separate from the final Wayland series. Both series retain every crowd pair.
